OUR HERITAGE & VISION

Two sisters.
One shared love.

Maezy was founded on an intuitive conviction: that fine jewellery should not be preserved in safety vaults for infrequent occasions. It belongs to everyday glamour, personal celebrations, and modern life.

THE ORIGIN

The Meaning of Maezy

The name Maezy draws inspiration from “mazy”—intricate, poetic, and full of beautiful twists and luminous turns. It simultaneously echoes the ancient Greek “mazí”, which translates to together.

For founders Mariya and Zahabiya, jewellery has always been more than an ornamental accessory. A single piece could transform a crisp white shirt, hold the memory of an intimate dinner, or lend quiet confidence in high-stakes rooms.

Traditional fine jewellery carries staggering retail markups—often exceeding 10x production costs. Maezy was created to eliminate the unnecessary markup while maintaining the identical weight, diamond-grade optical clarity, and hand-finished pavé settings of fine jewellery houses.

THE CRAFT

The Anatomy of Flawless Brilliance

Discover why our pieces hold their own alongside natural diamond couture.

5A Grade CZ Stones

5A is the absolute highest classification of cubic zirconia. Each crystal is cut with 58 proportional facets matching ideal diamond geometry to maximize light refraction and fiery dispersion.

Multi-Layer Micron Plating

Our brass foundation is electroplated with heavy coats of authentic 18K yellow gold or noble rhodium. This creates an impenetrable barrier against oxidization, tarnishing, and skin sensitivity.

Micro-Prong Pavé Settings

Rather than using cheap adhesives, every small accent stone is individually held by hand-pushed metal micro-prongs. Stones remain permanent, secure, and resilient against everyday wear.

PRESERVATION

How to Care for your Maezy Pieces

Treat your jewels with care and their radiance will remain timeless.

1. The "Last On, First Off" Rule

Put your jewellery on last after applying lotions, makeup, and perfume. Take it off first before showering, swimming, or retiring to sleep.

2. Dry Microfibre Polishing

Never use chemical silver dips or abrasive pastes. Gently buff the stones and metal surface with a dry, lint-free microfibre cloth.

3. Individual Velvet Storage

Keep each creation inside its designated Maezy velvet travel pouch to prevent friction and scratches between metal parts.

4. Avoid Moisture & Sweat

Avoid wearing your pieces during strenuous workouts or in steam rooms to preserve the lustrous micron plating.
